name: Frank B. B. Holmes
mentions: …ey, traveling auditor of the Northern Pacific railroad, is in town inspecting the accounts of Mr. Frank B. B. Holmes, our accommodating station agent. Mr. Holmes' ability as a railroad man is unquestionable, and, of course, everything was found in first-class order.  Mr. F. H. Ertel is…
George Auld of Belfield, was in Medora Tuesday, disposing of the hay put up by himself and Frank Holmes last summer. They had about seventy tons left out of three hundred.
